input: all 30,240 frozen scalar-encoding rows of the three-step Z/7 adaptive program
stage_law: at step k=1,2,3 an execution is live iff its saved first collision step is absent or at least k; a first hit has saved step k
bucket_key: visible label prefix before the next command; prefix lengths 2,3,4
weight_check: each eligible scalar in a collision-free prefix has exactly (7-prefix_length)! bijective encodings
stage_bounds: d=min eligible scalar count and c=max next-hit scalar count across observed buckets at that stage
raw_rows: one deterministic gzip JSONL row per visible-prefix bucket, including all eligible and next-hit scalar counts
claim_boundary: exact finite stopping ledger and conditional aggregation control; no asymptotic generic-group bound
